title: Ten slideshow tells
note:
Scored out of 10.
Advice only. A waiver names a second and a measured value.

rows: every scene enters and exits alike
hard cut, then a fade in
B starts after A fully left
one centred line on a still ground
shots within 15 percent of one length
a still camera and still content

parts.text:
A tell needs a repeat: 3 or more cuts, 5 or more elements, or a 75 percent share.
One crossfade for a time jump is a choice, not a tell.
